business_problem: Glencore Technology, a subsidiary of Glencore PLC, one of the world's largest, globally diversified natural resource companies, needed to upgrade its sales solution. The previous solution struggled with poor customer engagement tracking in addition to reporting—and lacked integration capabilities.
solution_summary: Glencore Technology modernized its sales operations by replacing a weakly integrated legacy sales system with Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, and Power BI. Working with Microsoft partner Data#3, the company unified pipeline management, customer engagement tracking, reporting, and workflow automation on a single business applications stack. Dynamics 365 Sales became the system of record for the sales process, Customer Insights improved visibility into customer activity, and Power BI gave leaders better reporting. The project also introduced Power Automate-based workflow automation to reduce manual effort, giving the mining-technology business a more scalable and data-driven way to run its global sales organization.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Centralizes pipeline and seller workflow data for the sales organization.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights
solution_components.role: Builds a unified customer view to improve journeys and engagement.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365
solution_components.role: Provides the core business application layer for operational workflows.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards and visualizations to business users and decision-makers.

business_outcome: Glencore Technology increased reporting and workflow efficiencies by 50 percent and reduced manual effort across the sales team by 25 percent after moving to Dynamics 365 Sales.
